channel.title: Web3 Hub
channel.description: Web3 Hub reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: EVM vs non-EVM blockchains: what changes for wallets?
item.description: EVM vs non-EVM blockchains differ in their virtual machines, addresses, tokens and wallets; those rules tell you where a wallet and asset can work.

item.title: How to Approve a USDC Bridge Cap in MetaMask
item.description: How to approve USDC spending for a bridge in MetaMask: verify the spender, set the cap to your transfer amount, pay gas, and confirm the allowance.

item.title: Crypto Yield Portfolio: A Monthly Vault Routine for Holders
item.description: Build a hands off crypto yield portfolio with auto compounding vaults by splitting assets across risk tiers, depositing once and reviewing status monthly.

item.title: How to build an ERC-4626 deposit and cooldown flow in Umbrella
item.description: Build an ERC-4626 deposit and cooldown flow by approving the underlying, depositing shares, waiting for maxRedeem, then previewing and redeeming inside the window.

item.title: Aave staking: How Umbrella covers reserve deficits
item.description: How Aave covers bad debt with staked funds: Umbrella records reserve deficits, then burns matching staked aTokens, passing losses to those asset’s stakers pro rata.

item.title: How to Withdraw ETH from an Exchange to Your Wallet Before Base
item.description: To withdraw ETH from an exchange to a self-custody wallet, choose Ethereum, verify the address and fee, approve the transfer, then track it on Etherscan.

item.title: How does a Sui burn unlock Ethereum funds?
item.description: Burning a bridged token on Sui triggers validator signatures; Ethereum verifies their stake threshold and nonce, then releases the original from the bridge vault.

item.title: Eigen layer restaking pros and cons: weigh yield and risk
item.description: Restaking pros and cons: EigenLayer can add AVS rewards, but also slashing, withdrawal delays and contract risk; compare stake-only, direct restaking and LRTs.

item.title: How to Bridge Monad Assets to a Different Ethereum Wallet
item.description: Can you bridge from Monad to a different Ethereum wallet? Usually yes: choose a supported asset, enter the recipient address when offered, then review and track delivery.

item.title: CoW Swap: How to switch networks before a token swap
item.description: Learn how to switch wallet networks before swapping tokens: select the chain in CoW Swap, approve the wallet prompt, then confirm the network and balance.

item.title: What is a virtual order in a TWAMM? A 100 ETH case
item.description: A virtual order in a TWAMM splits a long-term trade into tiny trades over time, then settles their combined effect on-chain at the pool’s next interaction.

item.title: How to split ETH across staking, liquid staking and restaking
item.description: How to spread ETH across staking, liquid staking and restaking: keep a plain ETH reserve, stake the rest, and restake only the share you can risk.

item.title: MetaMask allowances before bridging from Ethereum to Berachain
item.description: How to check token allowance in MetaMask before bridging to Berachain: match the source-chain token, wallet and bridge spender, then compare the amount.

item.title: US seeks forfeiture of $1.1 billion in Binance hack USDC
item.description: The Justice Department filed to forfeit more than $1.1 billion in USDC tied to Binance’s October hack, advancing recovery of funds already frozen by authorities.

item.title: How to use deBridge when you need tokens on another chain
item.description: How does deBridge work? DLN locks your source tokens, a solver pays you on the destination chain, then claims the locked tokens through deBridge messaging.

item.title: BlackRock Hong Kong tokenized fund reaches $100 million
item.description: BlackRock’s Hong Kong dollar fund began operations on Nov. 16 and had $100 million in assets by Nov. 20, offering tokenized units and stablecoin access to professionals.

item.title: Why does depositing an ERC-20 token to Polygon need two Ethereum transactions?
item.description: Depositing an ERC-20 token to Polygon takes two Ethereum transactions because approval grants the predicate permission, then the deposit locks tokens for Polygon PoS.

item.title: Wallet and DEX Compatibility When Networks Differ
item.description: To check whether a wallet works with a DEX, connect it on the intended network, confirm the token contract and balance, then test signing and a small swap.

item.title: Etherscan transaction details: What happened and what it cost
item.description: How do I read my transaction details on Etherscan? Search the hash, then use Status, From, To, Value, token transfers and Transaction Fee to confirm what happened.

item.title: EU proposes crypto crackdown in 22nd Russia sanctions package
item.description: The European Commission proposed restrictions on Russian banks and crypto networks on Nov. 23, but all 27 EU states must approve the package before it takes effect.
